title: DUEL BYTE
oneLiner: Outsmart the computer in a fast one-screen neon duel.
mechanics: Move your fighter left and right across the arena.
Press A to strike the rival when nearby.
Press B to dash away or close the gap.
Hits score points and briefly stun the rival; the computer grows faster over time.
lose: Lose when your health reaches zero.
scoring: Score one point for each successful strike.
